cards.example: 蒙古帝国非常强大，疆域辽阔无比。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Mongol Empire was extremely powerful, with an incomparably vast territory.
cards.breakdown: 强：弓（弓）加上小虫（虫），小虫拉开硬弓，力量惊人 · 大：人张开双臂，表示广大有力

cards.example: 元朝疆域辽阔，而且民族众多。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan territory was vast, and moreover its ethnic groups were many.
cards.breakdown: 而：像下巴上的胡须，表示转折或递进 · 且：像砖头一层层往上叠，表示还有更多

cards.back: to arouse / to stir up / to provoke
cards.example: 元朝的歧视政策激起了人民的强烈不满。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan's discriminatory policies provoked strong discontent among the people.
cards.breakdown: 激：水（氵）猛烈冲击（敫），溅起浪花 · 起：自己（己）走起来（走），出发行动

cards.example: 忽必烈大力发展农业和商业。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan vigorously developed agriculture and commerce.
cards.breakdown: 发：头发生长，引申为出发、蓬勃发展 · 展：把衣服（衣）展开铺平，引申为展现和发展

cards.example: 大都是当时世界上最大的城市之一。
cards.exampleTranslation: Dadu was one of the largest cities in the world at the time.
cards.breakdown: 城：用土（土）筑成的防御墙（成），保护里面的人 · 市：人们聚在一起买卖（巾）东西的地方

cards.exampleTranslation: The architecture of Dadu was grand and magnificent.
cards.breakdown: 建：拿着笔（聿）一步步走出去（廴），建造出来 · 筑：用竹（竹）模具和工具（巩）夯土筑墙

cards.example: 大都的城市布局严整有序。
cards.exampleTranslation: Dadu's city layout was orderly and well-organized.
cards.breakdown: 严：悬崖（厂）上挂着装饰（敢），气氛庄严肃穆 · 整：用棍子（攵）把歪的东西（束）摆正（正），整理整齐

cards.example: 大都的街道宽阔笔直，规划整齐。
cards.exampleTranslation: Dadu's streets were wide, straight, and well-planned.
cards.breakdown: 街：两个土（圭）夹着行人走的路（行），就是街道 · 道：在路上（辶）用头脑（首）找方向

cards.example: 元朝修建了许多大型水利工程。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan built many large-scale water engineering projects.
cards.breakdown: 工：像一把尺子，代表工匠和工作 · 程：用禾苗（禾）丈量路程（呈），表示过程和计划

cards.example: 元朝粮食产量大幅增加。
cards.exampleTranslation: Grain output in the Yuan Dynasty increased dramatically.
cards.breakdown: 产：在悬崖（厂）边生产东西，引申为产出 · 量：太阳（日）照着大地（里），丈量多少

cards.example: 多余的粮食可以用来做贸易。
cards.exampleTranslation: Surplus grain could be used for trade.
cards.breakdown: 多：两个月亮（夕）叠在一起，表示数量多 · 余：屋子（余）里还剩下的东西，用不完

cards.example: 元朝商人积累了大量资本，商业越来越繁荣。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yuan merchants accumulated large amounts of capital, and commerce grew increasingly prosperous.
cards.breakdown: 资：用次序（次）管理钱财（贝），就是资金 · 本：树（木）下面加一横，表示树根，引申为根本和本钱

cards.example: 元朝市场上商品种类繁多。
cards.exampleTranslation: The markets in the Yuan Dynasty had numerous varieties of goods.
cards.breakdown: 繁：像枝繁叶茂的大树，丝线（糸）纷纷交织 · 多：两个月亮（夕）叠在一起，非常多

cards.example: 棉布在全国各地销售，十分畅销。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cotton cloth was sold throughout the country and was very popular.
cards.breakdown: 销：用金属（钅）做的东西卖出去（肖），消化库存 · 售：把嘴（口）里的商品卖出去（隹），完成交易

cards.example: 元代青花瓷闻名世界，是中国瓷器的代表。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yuan blue-and-white porcelain was world-famous and a symbol of Chinese ceramics.
cards.breakdown: 青：像草木生长的颜色，蓝绿色 · 花：植物（艹）开出的花朵（化）· 瓷：用瓦（瓦）做成的光滑器物（次）

cards.example: 景德镇是中国最著名的瓷器产地。
cards.exampleTranslation: Jingdezhen is China's most famous porcelain-producing region.

cards.back: Suzhou and Hangzhou – two famously prosperous cities
cards.example: 元朝时苏杭是繁华的商业城市。
cards.exampleTranslation: During the Yuan Dynasty, Suzhou and Hangzhou were prosperous commercial cities.

cards.example: 元朝翻译了大量外国书籍，促进了文化交流。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan Dynasty translated many foreign books, promoting cultural exchange.
cards.breakdown: 翻：像鸟翅（羽）扇动，把东西翻转（番）过来 · 译：用语言（讠）把一种话变成（睪）另一种话
